name: frac-price-conversation-prep
description: Prepares one page for the fee call of a fractional engagement, with your number, your walk-away floor kept internal, your real alternative, the CEO's interests from their own words, your first two sentences, and what you can trade (days, phasing, terms) and what you will not. Use for "run frac-price-conversation-prep", "the fee call is tomorrow", "prepare me for the retainer conversation", "I always discount before they ask", "help me hold my retainer", "what do I say when the CEO pushes back on the fee", "negotiate my fractional retainer", part of the Claude for Fractional Leaders Pack by 90n.
